0022600211.text: The Knicks (4-4, winners of their last two, 7th in the East) host the Milwaukee Bucks (1-8, on a five-game losing streak, 15th in the East). New York is 3-2 at home, and Josh Hart is out with an ankle injury, while Milwaukee has yet to win on the road this season, going 0-4 away from home. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Knicks won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 127-98 win in Milwaukee on February 27, 2026.
